description: The headless password input core of the SvGrid UI kit in Svelte 5. SvPasswordInput is a styled renderer over createPasswordInput, which owns the reveal toggle and the four-level strength heuristic, exposed as inputProps and toggleProps. The same core drives the styled component and a custom reveal field plus strength meter, both bound to one value.

faq.question: What does toggleProps wire?
faq.answer: A button that flips the input between password and text type, with aria-pressed and an accessible label from the messages; inputProps reflects the current type.

faq.question: How is strength scored?
faq.answer: From length and the presence of lower case, upper case, digits and symbols, mapped to four levels the core exposes as a number and a label for any meter design.

faq.question: Is the value ever exposed unmasked?
faq.answer: Only through the bound value your app already holds; the reveal toggle changes how the input element displays it, nothing else.
